context: Two sisters trade tips after moving to new apartments
purpose: Teach: 国道/トンネル/タワー/ナイト/ムード/西部/入居/市販

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 新しい家、やっと入居できたの。庭は狭いけど、子どもたちは喜んでるわ。
lines.en: We finally moved into the new place. The yard is small, but the kids are happy.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, slightly weary but content with the move

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うちもよ。長いトンネル抜けてすぐの、駅前のタワーマンションに引っ越したの。
lines.en: Same here. We moved into a tower apartment right by the station, just past the long tunnel.
lines.style: Casual sisterly chatter with a touch of pride in her new home

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: タワーマンション？うらやましい。夜景がきれいで、ナイトクラブみたいなムードでしょ。
lines.en: A tower apartment? I'm jealous. The night view must give it a night-club kind of mood.
lines.style: Playful envy with teasing older-sister voice and light laughter

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: それがね、西の山が見えるだけで、意外と静かなのよ。
lines.en: Actually, you can just see the mountains to the west, and it's surprisingly quiet.
lines.style: Down-to-earth reply, gently correcting the glamorous image

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うらやましい。うちなんか国道沿いだから、車の音がずっと聞こえるのよ。
lines.en: Lucky you. Our place is along the national road, so we hear cars all the time.
lines.style: Practical mom-mode with slight exasperation about the noisy location

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら大変。それに夏は虫も入ってくるんじゃない？
lines.en: Oh, that's rough. And bugs probably get in during summer, right?
lines.style: Knowing little-sister sympathy with warm concern in her voice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうなの。だから市販の殺虫剤を、もう箱で買っちゃった。
lines.en: Exactly. So I went and bought a whole box of the regular store-bought insecticide.
lines.style: Resigned laughter, the everyday humor of motherhood and bug battles

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、効くといいわね。落ち着いたら遊びに来てよ、西部劇でも観ながらワイン開けましょう。
lines.en: Haha, hope it works. Once you're settled, come visit, we'll open some wine and watch a Western or something.
lines.style: Warm closing invitation, relaxed and welcoming sister-to-sister
